about: scripts/linked's bootstrap decision: a tree the linked parser cannot parse (a layout one behind, or a refused line of new syntax) is regenerated in two stages.

mutants.name: linked-refusals-ignored
mutants.rule: New syntax on the same node layout (a line the linked parser refuses) takes two stages under -bootstrap, and a plain run is refused with the instruction.

mutants.name: linked-walk-first-parent
mutants.rule: Stage 1's walk reaches a syntax port's parser behind a merge that kept the other side's linked compiler (I-FLIP s10: three merges back).

mutants.name: linked-walk-silent-fallback
mutants.rule: A walk whose commits hold the refused line and find no parser that reads the tree fails naming each one tried; stage 1 holds lines back only when no commit holds the line.

mutants.name: linked-final-check-removed
mutants.rule: The bootstrap's last stage ends with a parser that refuses nothing in the tree: held-back lines are a stage-1 state, never a result.
